text: {"assertions":["A malformed record bug was discovered in ingest/pipeline/parser.py that only affected jobs scheduled across midnight boundaries.","The root cause of the malformed record bug was connection pool exhaustion occurring under burst load conditions.","The bug could be reproduced by feeding a mixed-encoding sample file to the parser.","The bug manifested as a decode error pointing to a specific byte offset.","After the fix was applied, job processing time improved from 2 hours to 13 minutes.","The fix involved raising the connection pool ceiling and adding a bounded wait queue in front of it.","The fix was implemented in PR #2798 on branch fix/malformed-record-1."]}
